test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 18 April 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language ‘ROUBST’ is coded as 61. How will ‘FORTUNATE’ be coded in that language?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/12b2b5d42cbfabc47353746064b584639d915de2e9a567b18438b956c9d0d8a1.png] The logic followed here is :- **Sum of positional value of opposite alphabet - Number of letters in given word.** ‘ROUBST’ is coded as 61.
